profiles.name: Claude Remote
profiles.description: Remote Anthropic Messages API profile for first-breath/co-inhabitation harness evaluation. Requires an explicit model.remote.chat grant and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Allows capability_decision_context egress so the occupant receives its held-grant briefing and the results of capabilities it invokes (incl. armed perception summaries under a solo, user-consented dwell — the bystander floor is held by the run's solo constraint, not by starving the occupant of its own capability context).
